The scores from these paths indicate a moderate level of confidence in the proposed relationships, with the first path having a slightly higher score (0.6165) compared to the second (0.6048). The integration of these findings highlights a potential regulatory pathway involving Levodopa and MRP7, though further experimental validation is needed to confirm the direct interaction.
